predictions.static: Whole-stack KL above 1 nat at 0.25 (a no-refit cut of three quarters of every MLP).
predictions.token_topk: Far below static at every budget; under 0.3 nats at 0.25.
predictions.domain_doc: Better than static but by less than half at 0.25, because most important neurons are shared across domains; French, Chinese and code gain the most.
predictions.domain_token: Close to domain_doc: picking among eight domain sets per token adds little.
predictions.cluster_token: Better than both domain arms at every budget: co-activation clusters with K-of-64 routing are finer than eight domain sets.
predictions.shared_core: At 0.25, over half of each domain's set is shared by all eight domains.

criteria.primary: At budget 0.25, domain_token minus cluster_token domain-equal KL, paired document bootstrap within domains: upper 95% bound below 0 means the domain carve beats the co-activation carve; lower bound above 0 means the co-activation carve wins; otherwise a tie.
criteria.secondary: At budget 0.25, domain_doc's domain-equal KL as a fraction of static's. Under 0.5 means a document-level domain router recovers most of what a static prune loses.
criteria.tails: Copy-span mean and p99 token KL reported beside every mean; no arm is called better if its copy p99 is worse by more than 25%.
